QuestInfo.name: Obtain the Excellent Agent Badge!
QuestInfo.1:
Today's Mission! 
<Protect the Memory Chip and obtain #b1 Excellent Agent Badge#k!>

Today's mission is to obtain an #bExcellent Agent Badge#k. According to a trusted source, you can receive an Excellent Agent Badge by completing #bAgent W's#k #bMS-07 Mission#k.
When the time comes, #bAgentW#k will come find you...

0.0: Would you like to receive today's mission again?

yes.0: According to intelligence from a trusted informant, you can receive an Excellent Agent Badge by assisting #bAgent W#k complete #bOperation MS-07#k. \nWhen the time comes, #bAgent W#k will come to you. Please continue doing your best to trace the identity of #bMaster M#k.

no.0: Please let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Great job. You've completed today's mission. Your mission accomplishments will be reported to Headquarters. Have a nice day.
